title: Shift Reverses Direction (F, T, N, P, O)
instruction_text:
Shift often reverses direction or modifies scope!

Common Shift patterns:
  f/F = find forward/backward
  t/T = till forward/backward
  n/N = next/previous search match
  o/O = open line below/above
  p/P = paste after/before cursor
  a/A = append after cursor/at end of line
  i/I = insert at cursor/at start of line
  w/W = word/WORD (whitespace-delimited)

Your task: Delete all X's by searching BACKWARD.

Steps:
1. Press '$' to go to end of line
2. Press 'FX' to find X backward
3. Press 'x' to delete it
4. Press ';' to repeat F (backward again)
5. Press 'x' to delete
6. Repeat ';x' until all X's are gone
7. Save with :wq

Try 'f' when going forward, 'F' when going backward!
